1: # Arcade for All
2: 
3: > **Wrist-gesture controlled games for everyone** — powered by the [MbientLab MetaMotion](https://mbientlab.com/metamotion/) inertial sensor and [pygame](https://www.pygame.org/).
4: 
5: Tilt your wrist left and right to move a paddle. Flick your wrist up to launch a ball. Twist to put spin on it. No button presses, no joystick — the only controller is your body.
6: 
7: ---
8: 
9: ## Contents
10: 
11: 1. [Concept & Goal](#concept--goal)
12: 2. [Architecture Overview](#architecture-overview)
13: 3. [Tech Stack](#tech-stack)

24: 14. [External References](#external-references)
25: 
26: ---
27: 
28: ## Concept & Goal
29: 
30: MetaMotion Arcade explores **gesture-based interaction** as an accessible, intuitive alternative to traditional game controllers. The primary goals are:
31: 
32: - **Accessibility** — players with limited fine-motor control can use large, natural wrist movements instead of precise button timing.
33: - **Embodiment** — the mapping between body motion and on-screen action is direct and learnable: "lean left = move left."
34: - **Education** — the Calibration view teaches users what an inertial measurement unit (IMU) actually measures, turning the sensor into a learning tool.
35: 
36: The project targets the **MbientLab MetaMotion** family of wearable BLE sensors, which provide a compact 6-DoF IMU (accelerometer + gyroscope) that clips onto a wristband. A keyboard fallback mode lets the games run without hardware for development and testing.
37: 
38: ---
39: 
40: ## Architecture Overview
41: 
42: ```
43: ┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
44: │                        main.py                               │
45: │  Parses args, owns pygame display, drives the session loop   │
46: └──────────┬───────────────────────────┬───────────────────────┘
47:            │                           │
48:            ▼                           ▼
49: ┌──────────────────┐       ┌───────────────────────┐
50: │  shared/         │       │  home.py              │
51: │  sensor.py       │       │  HomeScreen           │
52: │  ─ BLE thread    │──────▶│  game selection menu  │
53: │  ─ IMUSample     │       └──────────┬────────────┘
54: │    data_queue    │                  │ selected game name
55: └──────────┬───────┘                  ▼
56:            │              ┌─────────────────────────┐
57:            ▼              │  games/                 │
58: ┌──────────────────┐      │  bricks/game.py         │
59: │  shared/         │      │  snake/game.py          │
60: │  gesture.py      │─────▶│  calibration/game.py   │
61: │  ─ Gesture-      │      │                         │
62: │    Interpreter   │      │  Each game:             │
63: │  ─ GestureState  │      │  run(gesture_src)→"home"│
64: └──────────────────┘      └─────────────────────────┘
65: ```
66: 
67: **Data flow:**
68: 1. `MetaMotionSensor` streams `IMUSample` objects (ax/ay/az/gx/gy/gz) over BLE into a thread-safe queue at ~100 Hz.
69: 2. `GestureInterpreter` drains the queue, applies a low-pass gravity filter, calibrates the neutral pose, and publishes a `GestureState` (tilt velocity, launch flag, spin, etc.).
70: 3. Games and the home screen call `gesture_src.get_state()` once per frame to read the latest gesture.
71: 
72: ---
73: 
74: ## Tech Stack
75: 
76: | Component | Library / Tool | Version |
77: |-----------|---------------|---------|
78: | Game engine & rendering | [pygame](https://www.pygame.org/) (SDL2) | ≥ 2.5 |
79: | BLE communication | [bleak](https://bleak.readthedocs.io/) | ≥ 0.21 |
80: | Numeric processing | [numpy](https://numpy.org/) | ≥ 1.24 |
81: | Language | Python | 3.9 – 3.12 |
82: | Platform | macOS 12+, Windows 10+, Linux (bluez) | |
83: 
84: **Why bleak over the official MetaWear SDK?**
85: The official [MetaWear Python SDK](https://github.com/mbientlab/MetaWear-SDK-Python) requires the `libmetawear` native shared library, which adds a compilation / packaging step. `bleak` is pure Python, cross-platform, and speaks directly to the MetaWear GATT service using the same protocol — so it works on any platform without a C toolchain. See `shared/sensor.py` for the raw BLE command protocol.
86: 
87: ---
88: 
89: ## Hardware — MetaMotion Sensor
90: 
91: This project targets the **MbientLab MetaMotion** sensor family:
92: 
93: | Model | IMU | Notes |
94: |-------|-----|-------|
95: | MetaMotion S | BMI160 (acc + gyro) | Recommended — compact, clip-on form factor |
96: | MetaMotion R / RL | BMI160 | Same firmware, larger chassis |
97: | MetaMotion C | BMI270 | Newer IMU; gyro register may differ (`0x04` instead of `0x05`) |
98: | MetaWear R / C / CPRO | BMI160 | Older hardware, same protocol |
99: 
100: ### IMU configuration used
101: 
102: | Parameter | Setting |
103: |-----------|---------|
104: | Accelerometer range | ±4 g |
105: | Gyroscope range | ±500 °/s |
106: | Output data rate | 100 Hz |
107: | BLE connection interval | 7.5 ms (requested) |
108: 
109: ### Sensor orientation
110: 
111: Wear the sensor on your wrist, **face-up** (LED / button towards the ceiling when resting).
112: 
113: ```
114:          ┌───────────────┐
115:          │  ● MetaMotion │  ← LED / button face-up
116:          └───────────────┘
117:               wrist
118: 
119:   X-axis ──► lateral (left / right)
120:   Y-axis ──► forward / backward
121:   Z-axis ──► up / down  (≈ –1 g when flat, gravity pointing down)
122: ```
123: 
124: More about the MetaMotion sensor: [mbientlab.com/metamotion](https://mbientlab.com/metamotion/)
125: 
126: ---
127: 
128: ## Sensor Gesture Mapping
129: 
130: The `GestureInterpreter` converts raw IMU data into game-friendly signals:
131: 
132: | Physical gesture | Signal | Used by |
133: |-----------------|--------|---------|
134: | Tilt wrist **left** | `paddle_velocity < 0` | Bricks paddle, home menu |
135: | Tilt wrist **right** | `paddle_velocity > 0` | Bricks paddle, home menu |
136: | Steeper tilt | Higher `abs(paddle_velocity)` | Bricks speed |
137: | **Flick** wrist upward (quick snap) | `launch = True` (one frame) | Bricks launch, home select |
138: | Rotate wrist **CW** | `spin > 0` | Bricks ball curve |
139: | Rotate wrist **CCW** | `spin < 0` | Bricks ball curve |
140: | Tilt wrist **forward** | `tilt_y < 0` | Snake up |
141: | Tilt wrist **backward** | `tilt_y > 0` | Snake down |
142: 
143: ### Auto-calibration
144: 
145: On startup the interpreter collects ~1 second of samples (100 samples at 100 Hz) to establish the **neutral gravity vector** while the sensor is at rest. All subsequent tilt measurements are relative to that baseline, so it doesn't matter which way the sensor is mounted on the wrist. During calibration, all gestures are ignored and a "Calibrating…" overlay is shown.
146: 
147: ### Low-pass gravity filter
148: 
149: A single-pole IIR filter with α = 0.05 separates slow gravity components from fast motion acceleration:
150: 
151: ```
152: smooth = α × sample + (1 – α) × smooth_prev
153: ```
154: 
155: At 100 Hz, α = 0.05 gives a ~2 Hz cutoff — slow enough to track gravity (DC), fast enough to follow deliberate wrist tilts, and immune to quick shaking.
156: 
157: ---
158: 
159: ## Game Modes
160: 
161: Three control and difficulty modes are available. Sensor modes can be toggled with the **M** key on the home screen.
162: 
163: ### ASTRA — Accessible Mode (default with sensor)
164: 
165: Designed for players who benefit from more forgiving timing:
166: 
167: - **Hold-required navigation** — on the home screen, a tilt must be held for 0.35 s before switching cards; a 2.5 s cooldown prevents rapid re-triggers.
168: - **Wider paddle** — the Bricks paddle is larger, reducing precision demands.
169: - **Slower ball** — ball speed is reduced.
170: - **No-fail bouncing** — in Bricks, the ball does not disappear if it passes the paddle; it bounces back from the bottom wall.
171: - **Snake wall-wrap** — the snake wraps through walls instead of crashing.
172: 
173: ### VEERA — Standard Mode
174: 
175: Standard play for users with full motor control:
176: 
177: - Edge-triggered navigation on the home screen (1.2 s cooldown).
178: - Normal paddle size and ball speed.
179: - Standard game rules (miss = lose a life, crash = game over).
180: 
181: ### Keyboard Mode (`--keyboard`)
182: 
183: Keyboard controls replace the sensor entirely. Ideal for testing without hardware. All sensor gesture features are replaced by key presses:
184: 
185: | Key | Action |
186: |-----|--------|
187: | ← → | Move paddle / navigate |
188: | ↑ ↓ | Snake direction |
189: | SPACE | Launch ball |
190: | ESC | Pause / return to menu |
191: | R | Restart |
192: | D | Toggle debug HUD |
193: | F | Toggle fullscreen |
194: | M | Cycle ASTRA ↔ VEERA (home screen) |
195: 
196: ---
197: 
198: ## Games
199: 
200: ### Bricks
201: 
202: Classic breakout game. Clear all bricks to advance to the next level.
203: 
204: **Sensor controls:** Tilt left/right to move the paddle. Flick up to launch. Rotate CW/CCW to curve the ball.
205: 
206: **Features:**
207: - 5 levels with increasing difficulty
208: - 6 brick colours each with different point values
209: - Power-up drops (wider paddle, extra life, multi-ball)
210: - ASTRA mode: no-fail bounce from the bottom wall
211: 
212: ### Snake
213: 
214: Grid-based snake game. Eat food to grow. Don't crash.
215: 
216: **Sensor controls:** Tilt left/right for lateral movement. Tilt forward/backward for up/down.
217: 
218: **Features:**
219: - Grid movement that speeds up as you score
220: - ASTRA mode: wall-wrap (snake passes through walls rather than crashing), fixed speed, intent-assist steers toward food on any gesture
221: - Keyboard arrows also work in both modes
222: - Full learn/test/guided/validation support — uses food-cell position as gesture label
223: 
224: ### Fruit Slice
225: 
226: 60-second arcade game. Fruits arc upward from below; sweep the cursor over them to slice. Bombs cost a life in VEERA mode.
227: 
228: **Sensor controls:** Yaw (abs_gz) → horizontal cursor; pitch (abs_gy) → vertical cursor. Cursor appears as a glowing slash trail.
229: 
230: **Keyboard mode:** Mouse cursor is the blade. Anything moving faster than 4 px registers as a slice.
231: 
232: **Features:**
233: - ASTRA mode: high sensitivity, very forgiving hit zones, auto-aim pull toward nearest fruit, no bombs, 3-star scoring at 10/20 slices
234: - VEERA mode: 3 lives, bombs, normal speed, combo multiplier (×2 / ×3)
235: - Full learn/test/validation support — uses real on-screen fruit positions as gesture labels (no guided mode; real fruits replace synthetic targets)
236: 
237: ### Calibrate *(sensor only)*
238: 
239: Four-panel aviation-style instrument display showing live sensor orientation. Opens as a game card on the home screen only when a sensor is connected.
240: 
241: ```
242: ┌─────────────────┬─────────────────┐
243: │  FRONT VIEW     │  SIDE VIEW      │
244: │  Roll           │  Pitch          │
245: │  (attitude AI)  │  (attitude AI)  │
246: ├─────────────────┼─────────────────┤
247: │  TOP VIEW       │  SENSOR DATA    │
248: │  Yaw / Compass  │  Live numbers   │
249: │  (compass rose) │                 │
250: └─────────────────┴─────────────────┘
251: ```
252: 
253: | Panel | What it shows |
254: |-------|--------------|
255: | **Front View** | Circular attitude indicator — sky/ground background rotates by roll angle; fixed wing symbol |
256: | **Side View** | Circular attitude indicator — horizon shifts up/down with pitch; side airplane profile |
257: | **Top View** | Compass rose (North = top); airplane silhouette rotates with integrated yaw |
258: | **Data** | Live pitch/roll/yaw angles; ax/ay/az (g); gx/gy/gz (°/s) |
259: 
260: **Angle calculations:**
261: - Pitch = `atan2(−ax, √(ay² + az²))`
262: - Roll = `atan2(ay, az)`
263: - Yaw = integrated `gz × Δt` (resets with SPACE; drifts without a magnetometer)
264: 
265: **Calibration panel controls:**
266: 
267: | Key | Action |
268: |-----|--------|
269: | ESC / Backspace | Return to home screen |
270: | SPACE / R | Reset yaw accumulator to 0° |
271: | F | Toggle fullscreen |
272: 
273: ---
274: 
275: ## Gesture Personalisation
276: 
277: Bricks, Snake, and Fruit Slice can each learn your specific movement style and use a personal ML model to drive the game — no configuration required. All data and models are stored per-user under `data/gestures/{username}/`. The system is powered by `shared/gesture_learner.py` and shared UI utilities in `shared/learn_test_support.py`.
278: 
279: > **Requirement:** `scikit-learn` is listed in `requirements.txt`. If it is missing, learn/test mode shows an "UNAVAILABLE" warning in the HUD.
280: 
281: ---
282: 
283: ### Submodes
284: 
285: Three submodes can be toggled at any time **while any game is running**:
286: 
287: | Key | Submode | What it does |
288: |-----|---------|-------------|
289: | **L** | Learn | Records labelled gesture samples as you play |
290: | **T** | Test | Your personal ML model drives the paddle / snake / cursor instead of raw gyro |
291: | **R** | Regular | Normal raw-gyro control; saves and retrains the model before returning |
292: | **G** | Guided toggle | Switches between guided and manual learn (learn mode only; Bricks & Snake) |
293: | **V** | Validation panel | Opens/closes the CV results panel (test mode only) |
294: 
295: A brief toast message fades in for 2.5 s whenever you switch submodes.
296: 
297: ---
298: 
299: ### Per-game differences
300: 
301: | Feature | Bricks | Snake | Fruit Slice |
302: |---------|--------|-------|-------------|
303: | Gesture directions learned | right, left | right, left, up, down | right, left, up, down |
304: | Learn target (label source) | Active ball x-position at paddle height | Food cell position | Real on-screen fruits |
305: | Guided mode | Yes (**G** key) | Yes (**G** key) | No — real fruits replace synthetic targets |
306: | Test mode effect | Drives paddle left/right | Changes snake direction | Drives cursor position |
307: | `● REC` flash on capture | No | No | Yes (centre-top) |
308: | Validation panel detail | Compact (accuracy + F1 table) | Compact | Detailed (+ confusion matrix, latency, tip) |
309: 
310: ---
311: 
312: ### Learn mode
313: 
314: Press **L** to start a learning session. Keep playing normally — data is captured automatically.
315: 
316: **How a sample is captured (same for all games):**
317: 1. A rolling buffer holds the last ~30 frames of raw IMU data (~500 ms look-back).
318: 2. Every frame, five quality guards run before anything is saved:
319:    - **Goal guard** — a target (fruit, ball, or food) must be present on screen.
320:    - **Cooldown guard** — at least 0.6 s must have passed since the last recording.
321:    - **Motion guard** — gyro magnitude must exceed 25 °/s (intentional motion only).
322:    - **Erratic guard** — rejects random jitter (gyro-magnitude std below 180 °/s).
323:    - **Ambiguity guard** — one spatial axis must dominate ≥75%; trajectory must agree with target direction.
324: 3. An 18-frame event-centred window (aligned to the motion peak) is extracted into a **38-feature vector** and saved with a direction label.
325: 
326: **HUD indicators while learning (bottom-right):**
327: - `LEARN  12 rec  [R=regular T=test]` — orange.
328: - `! imbalanced` appended if one direction has 3× more samples than another.
329: - `● REC` red flash in Fruit Slice only (centre-top) on each capture.
330: 
331: **Guided learning (Bricks & Snake only):**
332: 
333: Press **G** in learn mode to enable guided mode. The game walks through directions one at a time, requiring 8 clean captures each before advancing:
334: 
335: ```
336: GUIDED RIGHT 3/8 [G=manual]        ← Snake (all 4 dirs)
337: GUIDED RIGHT 3/8 [G=manual]        ← Bricks (right and left only)
338: ```
339: 
340: While guided is active, a synthetic target is placed in the prompted direction so `IntentLabeler` can label samples even without a real game object nearby. Press **G** again to return to free-form learning. Completing all directions and pressing **G** resets the flow.
341: 
342: **Session data** is saved to:
343: 
344: ```
345: data/gestures/{username}/sessions/session_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS.json
346: ```
347: 
348: ---
349: 
350: ### Test mode
351: 
352: Press **T** to switch to model-driven control.
353: 
354: - The ML model (a Random Forest, 60 trees, balanced class weights) predicts the intended direction from the current IMU buffer.
355: - Predictions are smoothed over 4 frames: the game only acts when one direction holds ≥60% of recent predictions.
356: - If confidence is below 55% or no consensus exists, control falls back to raw gyro at reduced scale — the game never freezes.
357: 
358: **How test mode drives each game:**
359: 
360: | Game | What the model controls |
361: |------|------------------------|
362: | Bricks | `get_cursor_delta()` dx mapped to `paddle_velocity` (left/right only) |
363: | Snake | `get_cursor_delta()` dx/dy thresholded at 0.10 to trigger direction changes |
364: | Fruit Slice | `get_cursor_delta()` dx/dy integrated directly into cursor position |
365: 
366: **HUD indicators (bottom-right):**
367: - `TEST  MODEL READY  [V=validate  R=regular  L=learn]` — cyan.
368: - `TEST  NO MODEL  (no data yet — press L)` — orange.
369: 
370: The model retrains from all saved sessions automatically whenever you leave learn or test mode.
371: 
372: ---
373: 
374: ### Validation panel
375: 
376: Press **V** in test mode to open the panel. Session-aware stratified k-fold CV runs in a background thread so the game keeps playing.
377: 
378: **Compact panel** (Bricks & Snake — less intrusive):
379: ```
380: MODEL VALIDATION  [V close]
381: 
382: Accuracy: 87%
383: 120 samples  6 sessions
384: 
385: Dir  F1   P   R    n
386: ────────────────────────────
387: R    91%  89%  93%  30
388: L    88%  90%  86%  30
389: 
390: FP rate: 8%    Unsure: 12%
391: ```
392: 
393: **Detailed panel** (Fruit Slice — includes confusion matrix and tip):
394: ```
395: MODEL VALIDATION  [V close]
396: 
397: Accuracy: 87%
398: 120 samples  6 sessions  5 folds
399: 
400: Dir  F1   P   R    n
401: ────────────────────────────
402: R    91%  89%  93%  30  ...
403: 
404: FP rate: 8%    Unsure: 12%    Latency: ~0.18ms
405: 
406: Confusion (true→pred):
407:      R   L   U   D
408: R    27  1   1   1  ...
409: 
410: Tip: practice ↓ down (F1=83%)
411: ```
412: 
413: **What the metrics mean:**
414: 
415: | Metric | What to aim for |
416: |--------|----------------|
417: | Accuracy | ≥ 80% is good; ≥ 90% is excellent |
418: | F1 per direction | ≥ 80% for each direction |
419: | FP rate | < 15% is acceptable |
420: | Unsure (abstain rate) | High = model needs more data |
421: 
422: The **Tip** line (Fruit Slice only) names the weakest direction when its F1 < 80%. Press **V** again to close.
423: 
424: ---
425: 
426: ### Tips for a good model
427: 
428: 1. **Collect at least 10 samples total** before the first training. 20+ per direction is ideal.
429: 2. **Use guided mode** (Bricks/Snake) to build a balanced dataset quickly — it automatically targets each direction in turn.
430: 3. **Multiple short sessions** across days train a more robust model than one long session.
431: 4. **Check class balance** — `! imbalanced` in the HUD means one direction dominates; focus there.
432: 5. **Run validation** after each session — the Tip line (Fruit Slice) or per-direction F1 table shows exactly where to improve.
433: 
434: ---

437: 
438: ### 1 — Clone and create environment
439:

450:

494: ---
495: 
496: ## User Guide
497: 
498: ### Wearing the sensor
499: 
500: 1. Attach the MetaMotion to your wrist using the clip or wristband.
501: 2. Position it **face-up**: LED and button facing the ceiling when your arm rests on a table.
502: 3. Hold your arm still for ~1 second while the game calibrates (green "Calibrating…" overlay disappears).
503: 
504: ### Home screen navigation
505: 
506: | Input | Navigate | Select |
507: |-------|----------|--------|
508: | Sensor | Tilt left / right | Flick wrist upward |
509: | Mouse | Hover | Click |
510: | Keyboard | ← → | Enter / Space |
511: 
512: In ASTRA mode, hold the tilt gesture for 0.35 s before it registers.
513: 
514: ### Playing Bricks
515: 
516: 1. Tilt your wrist slightly to move the paddle. Steeper tilt = faster movement.
517: 2. Flick your wrist upward to launch the ball when it's sitting on the paddle.
518: 3. Twist your wrist CW/CCW while the ball is in play to curve it.
519: 4. Clear all bricks to advance. Collect power-up drops when bricks break.
520: 
521: ### Playing Snake
522: 
523: 1. The snake starts moving automatically.
524: 2. Tilt left/right and forward/back to steer.
525: 3. Eat the red food dot to grow. Avoid your own tail (and walls in VEERA mode).
526: 
527: ### Playing Fruit Slice
528: 
529: 1. Fruits arc upward from the bottom of the screen. Sweep the cursor over them to slice.
530: 2. In sensor mode, yaw your wrist left/right and pitch it forward/back — the glowing cursor follows.
531: 3. In keyboard mode, move the mouse over fruits to slice them.
532: 4. **VEERA mode:** avoid bombs (grey circles with fuses) — slicing one costs a life.
533: 5. **ASTRA mode:** no bombs, generous hit zones, auto-aim pulls the cursor toward the nearest fruit.
534: 6. Press **L** to start training gestures, **T** to let the model drive, **V** (in test mode) to see accuracy stats.
535: 
536: ### Understanding Calibrate
537: 
538: 1. Open the Calibrate card from the home screen (sensor mode only).
539: 2. The screen shows four instrument panels.
540: 3. **Tilt left/right** → watch the Front View AI bank left or right.
541: 4. **Tilt forward/back** → watch the Side View AI pitch nose up/down.

604: | Symptom | Fix |
605: |---------|-----|
606: | "No MetaMotion device found" | Check BLE permission (macOS); sensor LED should blink blue; run `python main.py --scan` |
607: | Sensor connects but no IMU data | Try repositioning near the Mac; firmware may use `0x04` instead of `0x05` for gyro — edit `_CMD_GYRO_DATA_SUB` in `sensor.py` |
608: | Game feels jittery | Hold sensor still during calibration; increase `calibration_samples` in `GestureConfig` |
609: | Yaw drifts in Calibrate panel | Expected — gyro integration accumulates error. Press SPACE to reset |
610: | Window won't open on macOS | `brew install sdl2 sdl2_mixer` then `pip install --force-reinstall pygame` |
611: | `libmetawear not found` | This project doesn't need it — run `pip uninstall metawear` |

79: 
80: # Tilt navigation thresholds / timing
81: TILT_THRESHOLD     = 0.55
82: TILT_NAV_CD        = 1.20
83: ACC_NAV_CD         = 2.50
84: ACC_HOLD_REQUIRED  = 0.35
85: 
86: 
87: class HomeScreen:
88:     """
89:     Renders the scrollable game selection menu and blocks until a game is chosen.
90:     Accepts an existing pygame surface and clock (owned by main.py).
91:     """
92: 
93:     def __init__(
94:         self,
95:         screen: pygame.Surface,
96:         clock: pygame.time.Clock,
97:         mode: str = "standard",
98:         username: str = "",
99:         debug: bool = False,
100:     ):
101:         self._clock    = clock
102:         self.mode      = mode
103:         self._username = username
104:         self._debug    = debug
105: 
106:         self._games: list = self._compute_games()
107:         self._selected_idx: int = 0
108:         self._scroll_offset: int = 0    # index of leftmost visible card
109:         self._hover_idx: Optional[int] = None
110: 
111:         # Tilt navigation state
112:         self._tilt_dir: int       = 0
113:         self._nav_cd: float       = 0.0
114:         self._acc_hold_dir: int   = 0
115:         self._acc_hold: float     = 0.0
116: 
117:         # Glow animation
118:         self._glow_phase: float = 0.0
119: 
120:         self._init_layout(screen)
121: 
122:     def _compute_games(self) -> list:
123:         games = list(GAMES)
124:         if self.mode != "keyboard":
125:             games.append("magic_wand")
126:             games.append("calibration")
127:         return games
128: 
129:     def _init_layout(self, screen: pygame.Surface) -> None:
130:         self._screen = screen
131:         sw, sh = screen.get_size()
132:         self._layout_size = (sw, sh)
133:         self._W  = sw
134:         self._H  = sh
135:         self._is_fullscreen = not (sw == 800 and sh == 600)
136:         sc = min(sw / W, sh / H)
137:         self._sc = sc
138: 
139:         n_vis = min(len(self._games), VISIBLE_CARDS)
140:         card_h   = int(CARD_H  * sc)
141:         card_y   = int(CARD_Y  * sc)
142:         card_gap = int(CARD_GAP * sc)
143:         card_w   = int(CARD_W  * sc)
144: 
145:         # Centre the visible cards
146:         total_w = n_vis * card_w + (n_vis - 1) * card_gap
147:         margin  = (sw - total_w) // 2
148: 
149:         self._card_w   = card_w
150:         self._card_h   = card_h
151:         self._card_y   = card_y
152:         self._card_gap = card_gap
153:         self._margin   = margin
154:         self._n_vis    = n_vis
155: 
156:         self._font_title = pygame.font.SysFont("monospace", max(20, int(42 * sc)), bold=True)
157:         self._font_sub   = pygame.font.SysFont("monospace", max( 8, int(14 * sc)))
158:         self._font_card  = pygame.font.SysFont("monospace", max(14, int(22 * sc)), bold=True)
159:         self._font_desc  = pygame.font.SysFont("monospace", max( 7, int(12 * sc)))
160: 
161:         self._update_card_rects()
162: 
163:     def _update_card_rects(self) -> None:
164:         """Recompute visible card rects based on current scroll offset."""
165:         self._card_rects = []
166:         for slot in range(self._n_vis):
167:             x = self._margin + slot * (self._card_w + self._card_gap)
168:             self._card_rects.append(
169:                 pygame.Rect(x, self._card_y, self._card_w, self._card_h)
170:             )
171: 
172:     def _toggle_fullscreen(self) -> None:
173:         self._is_fullscreen = not self._is_fullscreen
174:         if self._is_fullscreen:
175:             new_screen = pygame.display.set_mode((0, 0), pygame.FULLSCREEN)
176:         else:
177:             new_screen = pygame.display.set_mode((800, 600))
178:         self._init_layout(new_screen)
179: 
180:     # ── Scrolling helpers ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
181: 
182:     def _clamp_scroll(self) -> None:
183:         max_scroll = max(0, len(self._games) - self._n_vis)
184:         self._scroll_offset = max(0, min(self._scroll_offset, max_scroll))
185: 
186:     def _ensure_selected_visible(self) -> None:
187:         """Scroll so that the selected card is in the viewport."""
188:         if self._selected_idx < self._scroll_offset:
189:             self._scroll_offset = self._selected_idx
190:         elif self._selected_idx >= self._scroll_offset + self._n_vis:
191:             self._scroll_offset = self._selected_idx - self._n_vis + 1
192:         self._clamp_scroll()
193: 
194:     # ── Public entry point ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
195: 
196:     def run(self, gesture_src) -> str:
197:         self._gesture_src = gesture_src
198:         pygame.mouse.set_visible(True)
199:         while True:
200:             dt = self._clock.tick(FPS) / 1000.0
201:             self._glow_phase = (self._glow_phase + dt * 2.5) % (2 * math.pi)
202:             self._nav_cd = max(0.0, self._nav_cd - dt)
203: 
204:             for event in pygame.event.get():
205:                 if event.type == pygame.QUIT:
206:                     pygame.quit()
207:                     sys.exit(0)
208:                 result = self._handle_event(event)
209:                 if result:
210:                     return result
211: 
212:             self._update_hover()
213:             result = self._handle_gesture(gesture_src, dt)
214:             if result:
215:                 return result
216: 
217:             self._draw()
218:             if self._debug and gesture_src is not None:
219:                 gs = gesture_src.get_state()
220:                 draw_gesture_debug_overlay(
221:                     self._screen, gs, self._W, self._H, self._sc, self._font_card)
222:             pygame.display.flip()
223: 
224:     # ── Input handling ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
225: 
226:     def _handle_event(self, event: pygame.event.Event) -> Optional[str]:
227:         if event.type == pygame.KEYDOWN:
228:             if event.key == pygame.K_LEFT:
229:                 self._navigate(-1)
230:             elif event.key == pygame.K_RIGHT:
231:                 self._navigate(1)
232:             elif event.key in (pygame.K_RETURN, pygame.K_SPACE):
233:                 return self._games[self._selected_idx]
234:             elif event.key == pygame.K_m:
235:                 self._cycle_mode()
236:             elif event.key == pygame.K_d:
237:                 self._debug = not self._debug
238:             elif event.key == pygame.K_f:
239:                 self._toggle_fullscreen()
240:             elif event.key == pygame.K_c:
241:                 # Trigger PCA Functional Calibration
242:                 if hasattr(self._gesture_src, "start_functional_calibration"):
243:                     self._gesture_src.start_functional_calibration()
244:             elif event.key == pygame.K_ESCAPE:
245:                 pygame.quit()
246:                 sys.exit(0)
247:         elif event.type == pygame.MOUSEBUTTONDOWN and event.button == 1:
248:             if self._hover_idx is not None:
249:                 global_idx = self._scroll_offset + self._hover_idx
250:                 return self._games[global_idx]
251:         return None
252: 
253:     def _update_hover(self) -> None:
254:         mx, my = pygame.mouse.get_pos()
255:         self._hover_idx = None
256:         for slot, rect in enumerate(self._card_rects):
257:             global_idx = self._scroll_offset + slot
258:             if global_idx >= len(self._games):
259:                 break
260:             if rect.collidepoint(mx, my):
261:                 self._hover_idx = slot
262:                 self._selected_idx = global_idx
263:                 break
264: 
265:     def _handle_gesture(self, gesture_src, dt: float) -> Optional[str]:
266:         if gesture_src is None:
267:             return None
268:         gs = gesture_src.get_state()
269:         if not gs.calibrated:
270:             return None
271: 
272:         if gs.launch:
273:             return self._games[self._selected_idx]
274: 
275:         direction = 0
276:         if gs.paddle_velocity < -TILT_THRESHOLD:
277:             direction = -1
278:         elif gs.paddle_velocity > TILT_THRESHOLD:
279:             direction = 1
280: 
281:         if self.mode == "accessible":
282:             if direction != 0 and self._nav_cd <= 0:
283:                 if direction == self._acc_hold_dir:
284:                     self._acc_hold += dt
285:                     if self._acc_hold >= ACC_HOLD_REQUIRED:
286:                         self._navigate(direction)
287:                         self._nav_cd    = ACC_NAV_CD
288:                         self._acc_hold  = 0.0
289:                 else:
290:                     self._acc_hold_dir = direction
291:                     self._acc_hold     = 0.0
292:             elif direction == 0:
293:                 self._acc_hold_dir = 0
294:                 self._acc_hold     = 0.0
295:         else:
296:             if direction != 0 and direction != self._tilt_dir and self._nav_cd <= 0:
297:                 self._navigate(direction)
298:                 self._nav_cd = TILT_NAV_CD
299: 
300:         self._tilt_dir = direction
301:         return None
302: 
303:     def _navigate(self, direction: int) -> None:
304:         self._selected_idx = (self._selected_idx + direction) % len(self._games)
305:         self._ensure_selected_visible()
306: 
307:     def _cycle_mode(self) -> None:
308:         if self.mode == "keyboard":
309:             return
310:         self.mode = "accessible" if self.mode == "standard" else "standard"
311:         self._games = self._compute_games()
312:         self._selected_idx = min(self._selected_idx, len(self._games) - 1)
313:         self._ensure_selected_visible()
314:         self._init_layout(self._screen)
315: 
316:     # ── Drawing ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
317: 
318:     def _draw(self) -> None:
319:         self._screen.fill(BG)
320:         self._draw_title()
321:         self._draw_scroll_indicators()
322:         for slot in range(self._n_vis):
323:             global_idx = self._scroll_offset + slot
324:             if global_idx < len(self._games):
325:                 self._draw_card(slot, global_idx, self._games[global_idx])
326:         self._draw_dots()
327:         self._draw_hint()
328:         
329:         gs = self._gesture_src.get_state() if hasattr(self, "_gesture_src") and self._gesture_src else None
330:         if gs and getattr(gs, "functional_calibrating", False):
331:             self._draw_overlay("CALIBRATING...", "Swing wrist LEFT and RIGHT repeatedly")
332: 
333:     def _draw_overlay(self, title: str, subtitle: str = "") -> None:
334:         dim = pygame.Surface((self._W, self._H), pygame.SRCALPHA)
335:         dim.fill((0, 0, 0, 180))
336:         self._screen.blit(dim, (0, 0))
337:         t = self._font_title.render(title, True, TEXT_CLR)
338:         self._screen.blit(t, t.get_rect(center=(self._W // 2, self._H // 2 - 20)))
339:         if subtitle:
340:             s = self._font_card.render(subtitle, True, DIM_CLR)
341:             self._screen.blit(s, s.get_rect(center=(self._W // 2, self._H // 2 + 20)))
342: 
343:     def _draw_title(self) -> None:
344:         sc = self._sc
345:         cx = self._W // 2
346:         title = self._font_title.render("SELECT YOUR GAME", True, TEXT_CLR)
347:         self._screen.blit(title, title.get_rect(center=(cx, int(52 * sc))))
348: 
349:         if self._username:
350:             user_surf = self._font_sub.render(f"Player: {self._username}", True, (150, 200, 150))
351:             self._screen.blit(user_surf, user_surf.get_rect(center=(cx, int(76 * sc))))
352: 
353:         sub = self._font_sub.render(
354:             "tilt or arrow keys to choose   •   flick / enter / click to play",
355:             True, DIM_CLR
356:         )
357:         self._screen.blit(sub, sub.get_rect(center=(cx, int(96 * sc))))
358:         self._draw_mode_badge()
359: 
360:     def _draw_mode_badge(self) -> None:
361:         sc    = self._sc
362:         meta  = MODE_META[self.mode]
363:         color = meta["color"]
364:         label = f"MODE: {meta['label']}"
365:         if self.mode != "keyboard":
366:             label += "   (M = switch)"
367:         surf = self._font_sub.render(label, True, color)
368:         rect = surf.get_rect(center=(self._W // 2, int(114 * sc)))
369:         pad  = pygame.Rect(rect.left - int(8 * sc), rect.top - max(2, int(3 * sc)),
370:                            rect.width + int(16 * sc), rect.height + max(4, int(6 * sc)))
371:         bg   = pygame.Surface((pad.width, pad.height), pygame.SRCALPHA)
372:         bg.fill((*color, 35))
373:         self._screen.blit(bg, pad.topleft)
374:         pygame.draw.rect(self._screen, (*color, 120), pad, 1, border_radius=max(4, int(8 * sc)))
375:         self._screen.blit(surf, rect)
376: 
377:     def _draw_scroll_indicators(self) -> None:
378:         """Draw left/right arrow indicators when more cards exist off-screen."""
379:         sc = self._sc
380:         cy = self._card_y + self._card_h // 2
381:         arrow_size = max(10, int(18 * sc))
382:         arrow_pad  = max(4,  int(8  * sc))
383:         color = (180, 180, 200)
384: 
385:         # Left arrow
386:         if self._scroll_offset > 0:
387:             x = self._margin - arrow_pad - arrow_size
388:             pts = [
389:                 (x + arrow_size, cy - arrow_size // 2),
390:                 (x,              cy),
391:                 (x + arrow_size, cy + arrow_size // 2),
392:             ]
393:             pygame.draw.polygon(self._screen, color, pts)
394: 
395:         # Right arrow
396:         if self._scroll_offset + self._n_vis < len(self._games):
397:             x = self._margin + self._n_vis * (self._card_w + self._card_gap) - self._card_gap + arrow_pad
398:             pts = [
399:                 (x,              cy - arrow_size // 2),
400:                 (x + arrow_size, cy),
401:                 (x,              cy + arrow_size // 2),
402:             ]
403:             pygame.draw.polygon(self._screen, color, pts)
404: 
405:     def _draw_dots(self) -> None:
406:         """Draw pagination dots below the cards."""
407:         if len(self._games) <= self._n_vis:
408:             return
409:         sc  = self._sc
410:         r   = max(3, int(5 * sc))
411:         gap = r * 3
412:         total_w = len(self._games) * (r * 2 + gap) - gap
413:         x   = self._W // 2 - total_w // 2
414:         y   = self._card_y + self._card_h + max(8, int(14 * sc))
415:         for i in range(len(self._games)):
416:             is_vis = self._scroll_offset <= i < self._scroll_offset + self._n_vis
417:             is_sel = (i == self._selected_idx)
418:             if is_sel:
419:                 clr = (200, 220, 255)
420:             elif is_vis:
421:                 clr = (90, 90, 120)
422:             else:
423:                 clr = (50, 50, 70)
424:             pygame.draw.circle(self._screen, clr, (x + r, y + r), r)
425:             x += r * 2 + gap
426: 
427:     def _draw_card(self, slot: int, global_idx: int, game_id: str) -> None:
428:         rect   = self._card_rects[slot]
429:         meta   = GAME_META[game_id]
430:         accent = meta["accent"]
431:         is_sel = (global_idx == self._selected_idx)
432: 
433:         pygame.draw.rect(self._screen, CARD_BG, rect, border_radius=10)
434: 
435:         if is_sel:
436:             self._draw_glow(rect, accent)
437:             border_clr = accent
438:             border_w   = 3
439:         else:
440:             border_clr = tuple(max(0, c - 120) for c in accent)  # type: ignore
441:             border_w   = 2
442: 
443:         pygame.draw.rect(self._screen, border_clr, rect, border_w, border_radius=10)
444: 
445:         sc = self._sc
446:         title_surf = self._font_card.render(meta["title"], True,
447:                                             accent if is_sel else DIM_CLR)
448:         self._screen.blit(title_surf, title_surf.get_rect(
449:             centerx=rect.centerx, top=rect.top + max(8, int(14 * sc))
450:         ))
451: 
452:         pad_h  = max(6, int(12 * sc))
453:         prev_h = int(140 * sc)
454:         preview_rect = pygame.Rect(
455:             rect.left + pad_h, rect.top + max(26, int(50 * sc)),
456:             rect.width - 2 * pad_h, prev_h,
457:         )
458:         self._draw_preview(game_id, preview_rect, accent, is_sel)
459: 
460:         desc_key = "desc_ac" if self.mode == "accessible" else "desc"
461:         for j, line in enumerate(meta[desc_key]):
462:             clr  = TEXT_CLR if is_sel else DIM_CLR
463:             surf = self._font_desc.render(line, True, clr)
464:             self._screen.blit(surf, surf.get_rect(
465:                 centerx=rect.centerx,
466:                 top=rect.top + int(205 * sc) + j * max(14, int(18 * sc))
467:             ))
468: 
469:     def _draw_glow(self, rect: pygame.Rect, accent: Tuple[int, int, int]) -> None:
470:         sc = self._sc
471:         for extra, alpha in ((int(14*sc), 35), (int(9*sc), 22), (int(4*sc), 12)):
472:             gw = rect.width  + extra * 2
473:             gh = rect.height + extra * 2
474:             gsurf = pygame.Surface((gw, gh), pygame.SRCALPHA)
475:             gclr  = (accent[0], accent[1], accent[2], alpha)
476:             pygame.draw.rect(gsurf, gclr, gsurf.get_rect(), border_radius=14)
477:             self._screen.blit(gsurf, (rect.left - extra, rect.top - extra))
478: 
479:     def _draw_preview(
480:         self,
481:         game_id: str,
482:         area: pygame.Rect,
483:         accent: Tuple[int, int, int],
484:         active: bool,
485:     ) -> None:
486:         prev_clip = self._screen.get_clip()
487:         self._screen.set_clip(area)
488:         pygame.draw.rect(self._screen, (10, 10, 20), area, border_radius=6)
489:         dim = 180 if active else 100
490: 
491:         if game_id == "bricks":
492:             self._draw_bricks_preview(area, dim)
493:         elif game_id == "snake":
494:             self._draw_snake_preview(area, dim)
495:         elif game_id == "fruit_ninja":
496:             self._draw_fruit_ninja_preview(area, dim)
497:         elif game_id == "magic_wand":
498:             self._draw_magic_wand_preview(area, dim)
499:         elif game_id == "calibration":
500:             self._draw_calibration_preview(area, dim)
501: 
502:         self._screen.set_clip(prev_clip)
503: 
504:     def _draw_bricks_preview(self, area: pygame.Rect, dim: int) -> None:
505:         sc = self._sc
506:         PALETTE = [
507:             (220, 60, 60), (240, 160, 40), (60, 200, 100),
508:             (60, 140, 240), (180, 60, 220), (240, 240, 60),
509:         ]
510:         bw   = max(6,  int(26 * sc))
511:         bh   = max(3,  int(10 * sc))
512:         cols, rows = 6, 4
513:         pad_x = (area.width  - cols * bw) // 2
514:         pad_y = max(4, int(6 * sc))
515:         for row in range(rows):
516:             for col in range(cols):
517:                 base = PALETTE[row % len(PALETTE)]
518:                 clr  = tuple(min(255, int(c * dim / 255)) for c in base)
519:                 bx = area.left + pad_x + col * bw + 1
520:                 by = area.top  + pad_y + row * (bh + 2)
521:                 pygame.draw.rect(self._screen, clr, (bx, by, max(2, bw - 2), bh), border_radius=2)
522: 
523:         pw = max(14, int(40 * sc))
524:         ph = max(2,  int(6  * sc))
525:         px = area.centerx - pw // 2
526:         py = area.bottom - max(6, int(14 * sc))
527:         pygame.draw.rect(self._screen, (min(255, dim), min(255, int(dim * 0.7)), 255),
528:                          (px, py, pw, ph), border_radius=max(2, int(3 * sc)))
529: 
530:         ball_r = max(2, int(4 * sc))
531:         bx2 = area.centerx + max(3, int(8 * sc))
532:         by2 = area.bottom  - max(10, int(24 * sc))
533:         pygame.draw.circle(self._screen, (dim, dim, dim), (bx2, by2), ball_r)
534: 
535:     def _draw_snake_preview(self, area: pygame.Rect, dim: int) -> None:

539:             pygame.draw.line(self._screen, (30, 30, 50), (x, area.top), (x, area.bottom))
540:         for y in range(area.top, area.bottom, CELL):
541:             pygame.draw.line(self._screen, (30, 30, 50), (area.left, y), (area.right, y))

543:         snake_cells = [(8, 4), (7, 4), (6, 4), (5, 4), (4, 4), (4, 5), (4, 6)]

556:         fcx = ox + 11 * CELL + CELL // 2

564:     def _draw_fruit_ninja_preview(self, area: pygame.Rect, dim: int) -> None:

566:         sc = self._sc
567:         fruits = [
568:             (0.22, 0.55, (215, 50, 50),  (160, 25, 25), 0.13),
569:             (0.50, 0.38, (60, 175, 60),  (210, 55, 55), 0.17),

579:             c   = tuple(min(255, int(v * fade)) for v in clr)

260:             self._loop.call_soon_threadsafe(self._shutdown_event.set)

323:     def _run_loop(self, address: Optional[str]) -> None:
324:         self._loop = asyncio.new_event_loop()
325:         asyncio.set_event_loop(self._loop)
326:         try:
327:             self._loop.run_until_complete(self._main(address))
328:         except Exception as exc:
329:             logger.error("BLE event loop error: %s", exc)
330:         finally:
331:             self._loop.close()
332: 
333:     async def _main(self, address: Optional[str]) -> None:
334:         if address is None:
335:             address = await self.scan()
336:         # Create the notification event in the BLE event loop so connect()
337:         # can await it to confirm CCCD notifications are actually arriving.
338:         self._notify_event = asyncio.Event()
339:         self._shutdown_event = asyncio.Event()
340:         if address is None:
341:             logger.error("No MetaMotion device found.")
342:             return
343:         await self.connect(address)
344:         if not self._connected:
345:             return
346:         await self.start_streaming()
347:         if self._streaming:
348:             await self._shutdown_event.wait()
349:         await self._teardown()
350: 
351:     async def _teardown(self) -> None:
352:         if self._streaming:
353:             await self.stop_streaming()
354:         if self._connected:
355:             await self.disconnect()

359:     async def scan(self) -> Optional[str]:
360:         """Scan for the first MetaWear/MetaMotion device and return its address."""
361:         logger.info("Scanning for MetaMotion device (%.0fs)…", self.scan_timeout)
362:         print(f"[sensor] Scanning for BLE devices ({self.scan_timeout:.0f}s)…")
363: 
364:         # NOTE: on macOS, Core Bluetooth assigns a per-host UUID instead of
365:         # the real MAC address.  bleak uses that UUID to connect correctly.
366:         devices = await BleakScanner.discover(timeout=self.scan_timeout)
367: 
368:         # Name-based match
369:         for d in devices:
370:             name = d.name or ""
371:             if any(k in name for k in ("MetaWear", "MetaMotion", "MWC", "MMS")):
372:                 self._device_name = name
373:                 print(f"[sensor] MetaWear detected: '{name}'  [{d.address}]")
374:                 return d.address
375: 
376:         # UUID-based fallback
377:         for d in devices:
378:             uuids = [str(u).lower() for u in (d.metadata.get("uuids") or [])]
379:             if METAWEAR_SERVICE_UUID.lower() in uuids:
380:                 self._device_name = d.name or d.address
381:                 print(f"[sensor] MetaWear detected (by UUID): '{d.name}'  [{d.address}]")
382:                 return d.address
383: 
384:         logger.warning("No MetaMotion device found in scan.")
385:         print("[sensor] No MetaWear/MetaMotion device found.")
386:         return None

388:     async def connect(self, address: str) -> None:
389:         """Connect via BLE and enable notifications."""
390:         logger.info("Connecting to %s…", address)
391:         print(f"[sensor] Connecting to {address}…")
392:         self._address = address
393:         self._client = BleakClient(address)
394:         try:
395:             await self._client.connect()
396:         except BleakError as e:
397:             logger.error("Connection failed: %s", e)
398:             print(f"[sensor] Connection failed: {e}")
399:             return
400: 
401:         await asyncio.sleep(0.5)  # let connection fully stabilize before CCCD write
402:         self._connected = True
403:         logger.info("Connected.")
404:         print(f"[sensor] *** CONNECTED  name='{self._device_name}'  addr={address} ***")
405: 
406:         # Enumerate GATT services so we can verify the expected UUIDs are present
407:         print("[sensor] GATT services on device:")
408:         has_cmd_char    = False
409:         has_notify_char = False
410:         for svc in self._client.services:
411:             print(f"  service  {svc.uuid}")
412:             for ch in svc.characteristics:
413:                 props = ",".join(ch.properties)
414:                 print(f"    char   {ch.uuid}  [{props}]")
415:                 if ch.uuid.lower() == METAWEAR_COMMAND_CHAR_UUID.lower():
416:                     has_cmd_char = True
417:                 if ch.uuid.lower() == METAWEAR_NOTIFY_CHAR_UUID.lower():
418:                     has_notify_char = True
419:         if has_cmd_char and has_notify_char:
420:             print("[sensor] ✓ MetaWear command + notify characteristics confirmed")
421:         else:
422:             print(f"[sensor] ✗ Expected chars missing — cmd={has_cmd_char} notify={has_notify_char}")
423:             print(f"[sensor]   expected cmd    = {METAWEAR_COMMAND_CHAR_UUID}")
424:             print(f"[sensor]   expected notify = {METAWEAR_NOTIFY_CHAR_UUID}")
425: 
426:         # Register notification handler for all data coming back from the device
427:         try:
428:             await self._client.start_notify(
429:                 METAWEAR_NOTIFY_CHAR_UUID, self._notification_handler
430:             )
431:             print("[sensor] Notification handler registered")
432:         except Exception as e:
433:             print(f"[sensor] start_notify FAILED: {e}")
434:             self._connected = False
435:             return
436: 
437:         await asyncio.sleep(0.1)
438: 
439:         # Diagnostic: send switch-module info request [0x01, 0x80] — the firmware
440:         # always responds with a notification, so this tells us whether the CCCD
441:         # subscription is actually delivering packets.  Wait for the first
442:         # notification via the event (created in the BLE loop) rather than a
443:         # blind sleep + counter check.
444:         write = self._client.write_gatt_char
445:         try:
446:             # ensure we have an event to wait on
447:             if self._notify_event is None:
448:                 self._notify_event = asyncio.Event()
449:             await write(METAWEAR_COMMAND_CHAR_UUID, bytes([0x01, 0x80]), response=True)
450:             print("[sensor] Sent module-info probe — waiting for notification…")
451:             try:
452:                 await asyncio.wait_for(self._notify_event.wait(), timeout=0.8)
453:             except asyncio.TimeoutError:
454:                 if self._notify_count == 0:
455:                     print("[sensor] *** No notification received — CCCD subscription may not be active ***")
456:                     print("[sensor]   (haptic works = write OK; no notification = read-back broken)")
457:                 else:
458:                     print(f"[sensor] ✓ Notifications confirmed ({self._notify_count} received so far)")
459:             else:
460:                 print(f"[sensor] ✓ Notifications confirmed ({self._notify_count} received so far)")
461:         except Exception as e:
462:             print(f"[sensor] Module-info probe failed: {e}")
463: 
464:         # Request tighter BLE connection interval (mirrors SDK's mbl_mw_settings_set_connection_parameters)
465:         # The device asks the host for 7.5 ms intervals; give the stack 1.5 s to negotiate.
466:         try:
467:             await write(METAWEAR_COMMAND_CHAR_UUID, _CMD_CONN_PARAMS, response=True)
468:             print("[sensor] Connection parameters requested (7.5 ms interval)")
469:         except Exception as e:
470:             print(f"[sensor] Connection params command failed (non-fatal): {e}")
471:         await asyncio.sleep(1.5)
472: 
473:         # Confirm connection with LED (solid green) + one haptic buzz
474:         try:
475:             await write(METAWEAR_COMMAND_CHAR_UUID, _CMD_LED_STOP,  response=True)
476:             await asyncio.sleep(0.05)
477:             await write(METAWEAR_COMMAND_CHAR_UUID, _CMD_LED_GREEN, response=True)
478:             await asyncio.sleep(0.05)
479:             await write(METAWEAR_COMMAND_CHAR_UUID, _CMD_LED_PLAY,  response=True)
480:             print("[sensor] LED → solid green")
481:         except Exception as e:
482:             print(f"[sensor] LED command failed: {e}")
483:         try:
484:             await write(METAWEAR_COMMAND_CHAR_UUID, _CMD_HAPTIC_BUZZ, response=True)
485:             print("[sensor] Haptic buzz sent")
486:         except Exception as e:
487:             print(f"[sensor] Haptic command failed: {e}")
488: 
489:     async def disconnect(self) -> None:
490:         if self._client and self._connected:
491:             try:
492:                 await self._client.stop_notify(METAWEAR_NOTIFY_CHAR_UUID)
493:             except Exception:
494:                 pass  # already unsubscribed (e.g. double-teardown race or BLE drop)
495:             await self._client.disconnect()
496:             self._connected = False
497:             logger.info("Disconnected.")
498:             print("[sensor] Disconnected.")

500:     async def start_streaming(self) -> None:
501:         """
502:         Start sensor data streaming.
503: 
504:         Preferred path: Bosch Kalman Filter sensor fusion (module 0x19, NDOF mode).
505:         The SF module controls acc/gyro/mag internally — raw modules 0x03/0x13 must
506:         NOT be started at the same time or the firmware disconnects.
507:         Fallback: raw acc/gyro (modules 0x03/0x13) when SF is unavailable.
508:         """
509:         if not self._connected or not self._client:
510:             return
511: 
512:         async def _send(label: str, payload: bytes, with_response: bool = True) -> bool:
513:             # Look up self._client at call time so reconnect mid-sequence is handled.
514:             if not self._client:
515:                 print(f"[sensor]   FAILED {label}: no client")
516:                 return False
517:             try:
518:                 await self._client.write_gatt_char(
519:                     METAWEAR_COMMAND_CHAR_UUID, payload, response=with_response
520:                 )
521:                 print(f"[sensor]   sent {label}  {payload.hex()}  response={with_response}")
522:                 return True
523:             except Exception as e:
524:                 print(f"[sensor]   FAILED {label}: {e}")
525:                 return False
526: 
527:         # ── 1. Probe SF module ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
528:         print("[sensor] Probing sensor fusion module 0x19…")
529:         count_before = self._notify_count
530:         probe_ok = await _send("SF_PROBE", _CMD_SF_PROBE)
531:         await asyncio.sleep(0.35)
532:         sf_available = probe_ok and (self._notify_count > count_before)
533:         print(f"[sensor] SF probe: {'available ✓' if sf_available else 'not available — using raw acc/gyro'}")
534: 
535:         # ── 2a. Sensor Fusion path ─────────────────────────────────────────────
536:         if sf_available:
537:             print("[sensor] Starting sensor fusion (NDOF — acc±4G gyro±500dps, config=0x31)…")
538:             # Pre-configure acc + gyro hardware modules BEFORE sending SF MODE.
539:             # The Bosch SF module picks up these config values when it starts.
540:             # We send CONFIG only — no subscribe/start so firmware stays quiescent.
541:             for label, payload in [
542:                 ("ACC_CONFIG",  _CMD_ACC_CONFIG),
543:                 ("GYRO_CONFIG", _CMD_GYRO_CONFIG),
544:             ]:
545:                 await _send(label, payload)
546:                 await asyncio.sleep(0.12)
547: 
548:             for label, payload, delay in [
549:                 ("SF_MODE",         _CMD_SF_MODE,         0.35),  # 3-byte NDOF mode only
550:                 ("SF_CORR_ACC_EN",  _CMD_SF_CORR_ACC_EN,  0.15),  # corrected acc  (0x04)
551:                 ("SF_CORR_GYRO_EN", _CMD_SF_CORR_GYRO_EN, 0.15),  # corrected gyro (0x05)
552:                 ("SF_EULER_EN",     _CMD_SF_EULER_EN,      0.15),  # euler angles   (0x08)
553:                 ("SF_CAL_EN",       _CMD_SF_CAL_EN,        0.15),  # cal state      (0x0B)
554:                 ("SF_START",        _CMD_SF_START,         0.50),  # start fusion
555:             ]:
556:                 ok = await _send(label, payload)
557:                 await asyncio.sleep(delay)
558:                 if not ok and label == "SF_MODE":
559:                     print("[sensor] SF_MODE failed — aborting SF path, falling back to raw")
560:                     sf_available = False
561:                     # If firmware disconnected us, reconnect before raw fallback
562:                     if not self._connected and self._address:
563:                         print("[sensor] Device disconnected — reconnecting for raw fallback…")
564:                         await asyncio.sleep(1.5)
565:                         try:
566:                             self._client = BleakClient(self._address)
567:                             await self._client.connect()
568:                             await asyncio.sleep(0.5)
569:                             self._connected = True
570:                             await self._client.start_notify(
571:                                 METAWEAR_NOTIFY_CHAR_UUID, self._notification_handler
572:                             )
573:                             print("[sensor] ✓ Reconnected — proceeding with raw acc/gyro")
574:                         except Exception as re_exc:
575:                             print(f"[sensor] Reconnect failed: {re_exc}")
576:                             return
577:                     break
578: 
579:         if sf_available:
580:             self._streaming = True
581:             self._using_sf  = True
582:             logger.info("Streaming started (sensor fusion).")
583:             print(f"[sensor] SF streaming started — waiting for corrected acc data…")
584:             for _ in range(20):        # up to 4 s
585:                 await asyncio.sleep(0.2)
586:                 if self._acc_notify_count > 0:
587:                     print(f"[sensor] ✓ SF data flowing — acc={self._acc_notify_count} "
588:                           f"euler={self._sf_notify_count} cal={self._mag_cal_state}")
589:                     return
590:             print(f"[sensor] No SF data after 4s (acc={self._acc_notify_count}) — falling back to raw")
591:             # Clean up failed SF attempt
592:             for p in [_CMD_SF_CORR_ACC_DIS, _CMD_SF_CORR_GYRO_DIS,
593:                       _CMD_SF_EULER_DIS, _CMD_SF_CAL_DIS, _CMD_SF_STOP]:
594:                 try: await self._client.write_gatt_char(METAWEAR_COMMAND_CHAR_UUID, p, response=False)
595:                 except Exception: pass
596:             self._using_sf = False
597:             await asyncio.sleep(0.3)
598: 
599:         # ── 2b. Raw acc/gyro fallback ──────────────────────────────────────────
600:         print("[sensor] Starting raw acc/gyro streaming…")
601:         for label, payload in [
602:             ("ACC_CONFIG",    _CMD_ACC_CONFIG),
603:             ("GYRO_CONFIG",   _CMD_GYRO_CONFIG),
604:             ("ACC_DATA_SUB",  _CMD_ACC_DATA_SUB),
605:             ("GYRO_DATA_SUB", _CMD_GYRO_DATA_SUB),
606:             ("ACC_SUBSCRIBE", _CMD_ACC_SUBSCRIBE),
607:             ("GYRO_SUBSCRIBE",_CMD_GYRO_SUBSCRIBE),
608:             ("ACC_START",     _CMD_ACC_START),
609:             ("GYRO_START",    _CMD_GYRO_START),
610:         ]:
611:             await _send(label, payload)
612:             await asyncio.sleep(0.12)
613:         await asyncio.sleep(0.25)
614:         self._streaming = True
615:         logger.info("Streaming started (raw acc/gyro).")
616: 
617:         for _ in range(14):   # up to 2 s
618:             await asyncio.sleep(0.15)
619:             if self._acc_notify_count > 0 or self._gyro_notify_count > 0:
620:                 print(f"[sensor] ✓ Raw IMU data flowing — acc={self._acc_notify_count} gyro={self._gyro_notify_count}")
621:                 return
622: 
623:         print("[sensor] No raw notifications — retrying without response…")
624:         for payload in [_CMD_ACC_CONFIG, _CMD_GYRO_CONFIG,
625:                         _CMD_ACC_DATA_SUB, _CMD_GYRO_DATA_SUB,
626:                         _CMD_ACC_SUBSCRIBE, _CMD_GYRO_SUBSCRIBE,
627:                         _CMD_ACC_START, _CMD_GYRO_START]:
628:             try:
629:                 await self._client.write_gatt_char(METAWEAR_COMMAND_CHAR_UUID, payload, response=False)
630:                 await asyncio.sleep(0.05)
631:             except Exception:
632:                 pass
633:         await asyncio.sleep(1.0)
634:         print(f"[sensor] After retry: acc={self._acc_notify_count} gyro={self._gyro_notify_count}")
635: 
636:     async def stop_streaming(self) -> None:
637:         if not self._connected or not self._client:
638:             return
639:         cmd = self._client.write_gatt_char
640:         if self._using_sf:
641:             for payload in [
642:                 _CMD_SF_CORR_ACC_DIS, _CMD_SF_CORR_GYRO_DIS,
643:                 _CMD_SF_EULER_DIS, _CMD_SF_CAL_DIS, _CMD_SF_STOP,
644:             ]:
645:                 try:
646:                     await cmd(METAWEAR_COMMAND_CHAR_UUID, payload, response=False)
647:                 except Exception:
648:                     pass
649:         else:
650:             for payload in [
651:                 _CMD_ACC_STOP,  _CMD_ACC_UNSUB,  _CMD_ACC_DATA_UNSUB,
652:                 _CMD_GYRO_STOP, _CMD_GYRO_UNSUB, _CMD_GYRO_DATA_UNSUB,
653:             ]:
654:                 try:
655:                     await cmd(METAWEAR_COMMAND_CHAR_UUID, payload, response=False)
656:                 except Exception:
657:                     pass
658:         # Turn off LED
659:         try:
660:             await cmd(METAWEAR_COMMAND_CHAR_UUID, _CMD_LED_STOP, response=False)
661:         except Exception:
662:             pass
663:         self._streaming = False
664:         logger.info("Streaming stopped.")

687:     async def _async_vibrate(self, duration: float = 0.15) -> None:
688:         """Async helper to trigger haptic buzz for duration seconds."""

690:             return
691:         try:
692:             ms = max(1, int(duration * 1000))
693:             lo = ms & 0xFF
694:             hi = (ms >> 8) & 0xFF
695:             payload = bytes([_MODULE_HAPTIC, 0x01, 0xF8, lo, hi])
696:             await self._client.write_gatt_char(METAWEAR_COMMAND_CHAR_UUID, payload, response=True)
697:             print("[sensor] Haptic (async) buzz sent")

699:             print(f"[sensor] _async_vibrate failed: {e}")

701:     async def _async_write(self, payload: bytes) -> None:
702:         """Fire-and-forget GATT write (used for read-trigger commands)."""
703:         if not self._client or not self._connected:
704:             return
705:         try:
706:             await self._client.write_gatt_char(
707:                 METAWEAR_COMMAND_CHAR_UUID, payload, response=True
708:             )
709:         except Exception as e:

712:     async def _async_save_calibration(self) -> None:
713:         """Read current sensor-fusion cal data via BLE, then write it back to NVM."""
714:         if not self._client or not self._connected:
715:             return
716:         try:
717:             self._pending_cal_data = b''
718:             await self._client.write_gatt_char(
719:                 METAWEAR_COMMAND_CHAR_UUID, _CMD_SF_READ_CAL_DATA, response=True
720:             )
721:             # Wait up to 500 ms for the notification containing the cal bytes
722:             for _ in range(10):
723:                 await asyncio.sleep(0.05)
724:                 if self._pending_cal_data:
725:                     break
726:             if self._pending_cal_data:
727:                 nvm_cmd = bytes([_MODULE_SENSOR_FUSION, 0x0C]) + self._pending_cal_data
728:                 await self._client.write_gatt_char(
729:                     METAWEAR_COMMAND_CHAR_UUID, nvm_cmd, response=True
730:                 )
731:                 print(f"[sensor] Calibration saved to NVM ({len(self._pending_cal_data)} bytes)")
732:             else:
733:                 print("[sensor] No calibration data received — NVM save skipped")
734:         except Exception as e:
735:             print(f"[sensor] _async_save_calibration failed: {e}")

737:     # ── Notification parsing ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
738: 
739:     def _notification_handler(self, _sender, data: bytearray) -> None:
740:         """
741:         Called by bleak in the BLE event loop for every incoming notification.
742: 
743:         MetaWear firmware notification format:
744:           byte[0] = module id
745:           byte[1] = register id / opcode
746:           byte[2..] = payload (varies by module)
747:         """
748:         if len(data) < 2:
749:             return
750: 
751:         self._notify_count += 1
752:         # Print first 20 notifications + any SF module notification (always log SF)
753:         is_sf = (len(data) >= 2 and data[0] == _MODULE_SENSOR_FUSION)
754:         if self._notify_count <= 20 or self._notify_count % 100 == 0 or is_sf:
755:             print(f"[sensor] notification #{self._notify_count}  module=0x{data[0]:02x} reg=0x{data[1]:02x}  len={len(data)}  raw={data[:8].hex()}")
756:

167:         Returns (roll, pitch, yaw) in degrees.
168:         Roll:  rotation around x-axis (typically ±180°)
169:         Pitch: rotation around y-axis (±90°, gimbal lock at ±90°)
170:         Yaw:   rotation around z-axis (±180°, drifts without magnetometer)
171:         """
172:         # Standard conversion from quaternion to Euler angles
173:         # See: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Conversion_between_quaternions_and_Euler_angles
174: 
175:         # Roll: atan2(2(qw*qx + qy*qz), 1 - 2(qx² + qy²))
176:         roll_rad = math.atan2(
177:             2.0 * (self.qw * self.qx + self.qy * self.qz),
178:             1.0 - 2.0 * (self.qx * self.qx + self.qy * self.qy)
179:         )
180: 
181:         # Pitch: asin(2(qw*qy - qz*qx))  — clamp to avoid numerical issues
182:         sin_pitch = 2.0 * (self.qw * self.qy - self.qz * self.qx)
183:         sin_pitch = max(-1.0, min(1.0, sin_pitch))  # clamp to [-1, 1]
184:         pitch_rad = math.asin(sin_pitch)
185: 
186:         # Yaw: atan2(2(qw*qz + qx*qy), 1 - 2(qy² + qz²))
187:         yaw_rad = math.atan2(
188:             2.0 * (self.qw * self.qz + self.qx * self.qy),
189:             1.0 - 2.0 * (self.qy * self.qy + self.qz * self.qz)
190:         )
191: 
192:         return (
193:             math.degrees(roll_rad),
194:             math.degrees(pitch_rad),
195:             math.degrees(yaw_rad)
196:         )

198:     def get_linear_accel(self, ax: float, ay: float, az: float) -> tuple:
199:         """
200:         Remove gravity component from raw accelerometer reading.
201: 
202:         Rotates the expected world-frame gravity [0, 0, g] into sensor frame using
203:         the current quaternion, then subtracts from the measured accel.
204: 
205:         Args:
206:             ax, ay, az: raw accelerometer in g
207: 
208:         Returns:
209:             (lin_ax, lin_ay, lin_az): gravity-removed acceleration in g
210:         """
211:         # Expected gravity in sensor frame = inverse-rotate world [0, 0, 1]
212:         # Inverse quaternion rotation: q_inv ⊗ v ⊗ q, where v = [0, 0, 0, g]
213:         # Simplified (since v only has z component):
214:         grav_x = 2.0 * (self.qx * self.qz - self.qw * self.qy)
215:         grav_y = 2.0 * (self.qw * self.qx + self.qy * self.qz)
216:         grav_z = 1.0 - 2.0 * (self.qx * self.qx + self.qy * self.qy)
217: 
218:         return (
219:             ax - grav_x,
220:             ay - grav_y,
221:             az - grav_z
222:         )

2: gesture_detector.py — Slice gesture detection using gyroscope data
3: 
4: Detects "slicing" gestures (rapid wrist motion) from gyroscope angular velocity.
5: Also tracks combo chains when slices occur in rapid succession.
6: 
7: Architecture:
8:   - 8-frame rolling window of gyro samples
9:   - Slice event triggered when: peak angular velocity >= threshold AND cooldown elapsed
10:   - Direction classified from mean gyro components (left/right/up/down/diagonal)
11:   - Combo count via timestamp history within a sliding time window
12: """
13: 
14: import math
15: import time
16: from collections import deque
17: from dataclasses import dataclass
18: from typing import Optional
19: 
20: 
21: # ── Configuration Constants ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
22: 
23: AV_THRESHOLD = 150.0        # degrees/second — threshold for "slicing" motion
24: COMBO_WINDOW_SECS = 1.5     # time window for counting consecutive slices as combo
25: SLICE_COOLDOWN = 0.25       # minimum seconds between detectable slices
26: WINDOW_SIZE = 8             # number of frames in rolling window (~80ms at 100 Hz)
27: 
28: 
29: # ── Data Classes ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
30: 
31: @dataclass
32: class SliceEvent:
33:     """Represents one detected slice gesture."""
34:     direction: str          # "left"|"right"|"up"|"down"|"diagonal_ul"|"diagonal_ur"|"diagonal_dl"|"diagonal_dr"
35:     speed_norm: float       # 0..1 normalized speed (peak AV / (threshold × 3))
36:     av_magnitude: float     # raw peak angular velocity magnitude (°/s) during the gesture
37:     timestamp: float        # monotonic time of event
38: 
39: 
40: # ── Detector Class ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
41: 
42: class SliceDetector:
43:     """
44:     Detects slice gestures from gyroscope angular velocity.
45: 
46:     Rolling 8-frame window fires a SliceEvent when:
47:       1. Peak angular velocity (over all 8 frames) >= AV_THRESHOLD
48:       2. Cooldown has elapsed since the last slice
49:       3. On each frame until cooldown expires
50:     """
51: 
52:     def __init__(self):
53:         """Initialize detector with empty window and history."""
54:         # Rolling window: deque of (gx, gy, gz, av_mag, timestamp)
55:         self._window: deque = deque(maxlen=WINDOW_SIZE)
56: 
57:         # Cooldown tracking
58:         self._last_slice_time: float = 0.0
59: 
60:         # Combo tracking: deque of slice timestamps within combo window
61:         self._slice_history: deque = deque()
62: 
63:     def update(self, gx: float, gy: float, gz: float,
64:                t: Optional[float] = None) -> Optional[SliceEvent]:
65:         """
66:         Process one frame of gyro data.
67: 
68:         Args:
69:             gx, gy, gz: gyroscope values in degrees/second
70:             t: timestamp (monotonic); uses time.monotonic() if None
71: 
72:         Returns:
73:             SliceEvent if a slice is detected, else None
74:         """
75:         if t is None:
76:             t = time.monotonic()
77: 
78:         # Compute angular velocity magnitude
79:         av_mag = math.sqrt(gx*gx + gy*gy + gz*gz)
80: 
81:         # Push to rolling window
82:         self._window.append((gx, gy, gz, av_mag, t))
83: 
84:         # Need a full window to detect
85:         if len(self._window) < WINDOW_SIZE:
86:             return None
87: 
88:         # Check cooldown: must wait before next slice event
89:         if t - self._last_slice_time < SLICE_COOLDOWN:
90:             return None
91: 
92:         # Find peak AV magnitude in the window
93:         peak_av = max(frame[3] for frame in self._window)
94: 
95:         # Check threshold
96:         if peak_av < AV_THRESHOLD:
97:             return None
98: 
99:         # ── Detect slice ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
100:         # Compute mean gyro components over the window
101:         mean_gx = sum(frame[0] for frame in self._window) / WINDOW_SIZE
102:         mean_gy = sum(frame[1] for frame in self._window) / WINDOW_SIZE
103:         mean_gz = sum(frame[2] for frame in self._window) / WINDOW_SIZE
104: 
105:         # Classify direction
106:         direction = self._classify_direction(mean_gx, mean_gy, mean_gz)
107: 
108:         # Normalize speed: 0 at threshold, 1 at (threshold × 3)
109:         speed_norm = min(1.0, max(0.0, (peak_av - AV_THRESHOLD) / (AV_THRESHOLD * 2)))
110: 
111:         # Update cooldown and combo
112:         self._last_slice_time = t
113:         self._slice_history.append(t)
114: 
115:         # Prune old combo history
116:         cutoff = t - COMBO_WINDOW_SECS
117:         while self._slice_history and self._slice_history[0] < cutoff:
118:             self._slice_history.popleft()
119: 
120:         return SliceEvent(
121:             direction=direction,
122:             speed_norm=speed_norm,
123:             av_magnitude=peak_av,
124:             timestamp=t,
125:         )
126: 
127:     def _classify_direction(self, mean_gx: float, mean_gy: float, mean_gz: float) -> str:
128:         """
129:         Classify slice direction from mean gyro components.
130: 
131:         gz controls yaw (horizontal):
132:           gz > 0  → rightward wrist rotation
133:           gz < 0  → leftward
134: 
135:         gy controls pitch (vertical):
136:           gy > 0  → upward wrist pitch (palm facing you)
137:           gy < 0  → downward (palm away)
138: 
139:         gx controls roll (twist) — less relevant for slicing direction.
140: 
141:         Returns one of: "left", "right", "up", "down",
142:                         "diagonal_ul", "diagonal_ur", "diagonal_dl", "diagonal_dr"
143:         """
144:         abs_gz = abs(mean_gz)
145:         abs_gy = abs(mean_gy)
146: 
147:         # Threshold for "primary" axis dominance (1.5x ratio)
148:         AXIS_RATIO = 1.5
149: 
150:         if abs_gz > abs_gy * AXIS_RATIO:
151:             # Horizontal dominant
152:             return "right" if mean_gz > 0 else "left"
153:         elif abs_gy > abs_gz * AXIS_RATIO:
154:             # Vertical dominant
155:             return "up" if mean_gy < 0 else "down"
156:         else:
157:             # Mixed diagonal — combine both axes
158:             gz_dir = "r" if mean_gz > 0 else "l"
159:             gy_dir = "u" if mean_gy < 0 else "d"
160:             return f"diagonal_{gy_dir}{gz_dir}"
161: 
162:     @property
163:     def combo_count(self) -> int:
164:         """
165:         Number of slices detected within the current combo window.
166: 
167:         Prunes entries older than COMBO_WINDOW_SECS before returning count.
168:         """
169:         now = time.monotonic()
170:         cutoff = now - COMBO_WINDOW_SECS
171: 
172:         # Prune old entries
173:         while self._slice_history and self._slice_history[0] < cutoff:
174:             self._slice_history.popleft()
175: 
176:         return len(self._slice_history)

101: class AudioManager:

103:     Procedural music and sound effects for MetaMotion Arcade.
104: 
105:     Public API
106:     ──────────
107:       start_background()   — loop the gameplay music
108:       stop_background()    — stop music (e.g. on home screen)
109:       play_collect()       — play fruit/brick-collect chime
110:     """
111: 
112:     def __init__(self) -> None:
113:         info = pygame.mixer.get_init()
114:         if not info:
115:             pygame.mixer.init(44100, -16, 2, 512)
116:             info = pygame.mixer.get_init()
117:         self._rate  = info[0]
118:         self._chans = info[2]

120:         self._bg_sound      = self._to_sound(self._build_bg_loop())
121:         self._collect_sound = self._to_sound(self._build_collect())
122:         self._flick_cast_sound = self._to_sound(self._build_flick_cast())
123:         self._complete_fanfare_sound = self._to_sound(self._build_complete_fanfare())

128:         self._complete_fanfare_sound.set_volume(0.75)

130:     # ── Wave generators ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────

132:     def _square_tone(self, freq: float, dur: float, amp: float = 0.14) -> np.ndarray:
133:         """
134:         Bright square-wave-ish tone built from odd harmonics.
135:         Great for melodic leads — sounds like classic 8-bit game music.
136:         """
137:         if freq <= 0 or dur <= 0:
138:             return np.zeros(max(1, int(self._rate * dur)), dtype=np.int16)
139:         n = int(self._rate * dur)
140:         t = np.linspace(0, dur, n, endpoint=False)
141:         # Odd harmonic series approximates a square wave
142:         wave = (
143:             np.sin(_PI2 * freq       * t)
144:           + 0.333 * np.sin(_PI2 * freq * 3 * t)   # 3rd harmonic
145:           + 0.200 * np.sin(_PI2 * freq * 5 * t)   # 5th harmonic
146:           + 0.143 * np.sin(_PI2 * freq * 7 * t)   # 7th harmonic
147:         )
148:         wave *= amp / 1.676   # normalise sum of amplitudes
149:         # Snappy ADSR: very fast attack, gentle release (preserves rhythm)
150:         env  = np.ones(n, dtype=np.float32)
151:         att  = max(1, int(n * 0.03))
152:         rel  = max(1, int(n * 0.28))
153:         env[:att]  = np.linspace(0.0, 1.0, att)
154:         env[-rel:] = np.linspace(1.0, 0.0, rel)
155:         return (wave * env * 32767).clip(-32767, 32767).astype(np.int16)

157:     def _triangle_tone(self, freq: float, dur: float, amp: float = 0.16) -> np.ndarray:
158:         """
159:         Warm triangle-wave tone (mellow, great for bass).
160:         Triangle wave = odd harmonics with amplitude ∝ 1/n².
161:         """
162:         if freq <= 0 or dur <= 0:
163:             return np.zeros(max(1, int(self._rate * dur)), dtype=np.int16)
164:         n = int(self._rate * dur)
165:         t = np.linspace(0, dur, n, endpoint=False)
166:         wave = (
167:             np.sin(_PI2 * freq       * t)
168:           - 0.111 * np.sin(_PI2 * freq * 3 * t)   # 3rd (negative for triangle shape)
169:           + 0.040 * np.sin(_PI2 * freq * 5 * t)
170:           - 0.020 * np.sin(_PI2 * freq * 7 * t)
171:         )
172:         wave *= amp / 1.171
173:         env  = np.ones(n, dtype=np.float32)
174:         att  = max(1, int(n * 0.02))
175:         rel  = max(1, int(n * 0.40))   # longer release for warmth
176:         env[:att]  = np.linspace(0.0, 1.0, att)
177:         env[-rel:] = np.linspace(1.0, 0.0, rel)
178:         return (wave * env * 32767).clip(-32767, 32767).astype(np.int16)
